lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-7 per vertical column) arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the 5th gill slit. Inter-centroid distance increases slightly along the longitudinal axis toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (light gray/blue) intersect with circular high-luminance blobs, effectively centering the blobs within the vertical stripes to form a repeating grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from a light-reflective dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the head and the proximal region of the left pectoral fin.
